# Legacy Style Reference (Do Not Edit Originals)

This folder is a stable reference map for recreating the old website look.

Rules:
- Do not edit files under `static/` and `admin/` when using them as visual/style references.
- Use this `ref/` folder as the source-of-truth index for legacy style parity work.
- If new parity tasks are added, update mapping files in `ref/`, not legacy files.

Primary legacy style sources:
- `static/style.css`
- `static/css/login.css`
- `static/css/button.css`
- `static/css/cart.css`
- `admin/style.css`
- `admin/product.css`

Primary legacy markup references:
- `static/index.html`
- `static/store.html`
- `static/cart.html`
- `static/news.html`
- `static/about.html`
- `static/xuhuong.html`
- `admin/login.html`
- `admin/product.html`
